brand_search.read: Brand clicks rose 20.5% between the halves. 2 brand searches ask about an affiliate or referral program (15 clicks in the second half): partners are already looking. 2 ask for a promo or discount code (53 clicks): a shared code would leak to coupon sites, so use one-time links.

recommendation.rule: Both rows of the table hold. Customer referral: `purchase` is tracked, 337 people a month reach the first-value moment (50 or more needed), and customers already share their booking pages with clients (share_booking_link fired 1,240 times). Affiliate or partner: 6 outside senders engage at or above the site rate, 2 brand searches already ask about a program, and the budget allows 25% (10% or more needed).
recommendation.customer_referral: A simple two-sided program with smaller rewards, paid in account credit.
recommendation.partner_program: Larger commissions (25% of first-year revenue) for the forums, newsletters, tools and consultants below.

outreach_note_draft:
Subject: A partner program for salonowners-forum.example

Hi [Name],

Your community sent us 820 visitors in the last 90 days, and 72% of them engaged, against 59% for our site overall, so your members are the owners we build for. We're starting a small partner program and would like you in it: 25% of each referred customer's first-year revenue, a 30-day cookie window and monthly payouts. You'd get your own link, an account to try the product and a one-page summary of who it is for.

Would you like the details?

[Your name]
